notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at VFS New Delhi
notes.title: Your 10 November clashes
notes.text: Your VFS slot is 2:45pm Delhi time on the 10th, and the Campus France counselling shows as 5pm Jakarta time the same day, which is 3:30pm in Delhi. So the session meant to settle the EEF transfer starts while you are inside the visa centre. - Worth asking Muskan to move it earlier.
